verdict.rationale: Netlify is a hosting and deployment platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The pack never mentions MCP. The nearest item (netlify-docs-22) says Netlify can 'connect AI assistants to your Netlify account' but names no protocol or server, so it is adjacent evidence and earns no credit. The CLI, REST API and llms.txt are developer building blocks, not an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
